verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents real-time event streaming and observability (Webhook Streaming, tracing/observability, performance monitoring of execution times/tokens) that could feed a UI, but this is an Enterprise/AMP webhook feature aimed at 'systems' integration, not a documented token-by-token LLM output streaming API or intermediate step callback intended for building a live UI. Missing for 10: explicit token-level streaming API/callback for LLM output, documented UI-facing event schema for tool calls/steps, and independent/hands-on confirmation of real-time UI streaming.
